content.text: I should add that the above PR implements a fedora to solr connector. What remains in this ticket is to do the same for an external triplestore.
PR-16 is pending response to minor code review comments.
Updated PR in response to code comments
Second part to this ticket has been resolved with:
In addition to copying the project shells, add unit/integration tests.
(I imagine that the "examples" will remain in fcrepo-camel, but without the testing, etc)
